theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 16 群

items.colloc: put down in writing 書面記錄 | put down a deposit 支付訂金
items.distinct: write down 寫下（強調資訊） | note down 隨手記下
ex: Please put down your contact details on this form.
請在表格上寫下您的聯絡資訊。
We decided to put down a deposit for the equipment.
我們決定為這項設備支付訂金。
Never put down your colleagues during a team meeting.
在團隊會議中絕不要貶低你的同事。

items.colloc: put forward a proposal 提出提案 | put forward a suggestion 提出建議
items.distinct: bring up 提及（話題） | propose 提議（較正式）
ex: Several managers put forward new ideas for the project.
幾位經理為這項計畫提出了新構想。
The committee will put forward a candidate for the role.
委員會將推薦一名候選人擔任該職位。
She put forward a compelling argument during the negotiation.
她在談判中提出了具說服力的觀點。

items.colloc: put in an offer on a house 對房屋出價 | accept an offer 接受報價
items.distinct: make a bid 競標 | submit a quote 提交報價單
ex: We decided to put in an offer on the office building.
我們決定對該辦公大樓出價。
They put in an offer shortly after the property listing.
他們在房產刊登後不久就提出了報價。
Are you planning to put in an offer for this contract?
你打算為這份合約投標嗎？

items.colloc: put in for a transfer 申請調職 | put in for a raise 申請加薪
items.distinct: apply for 申請（通用） | request 要求
ex: I have decided to put in for a transfer to Tokyo.
我已經決定申請調職到東京。
He put in for a week of vacation starting next Monday.
他申請了從下週一開始的一週假期。
She put in for a promotion after completing the certification.
她在完成認證後申請了升遷。

items.colloc: put new policies into effect 實施新政策 | come into effect 開始生效
items.distinct: carry out 執行（任務） | implement 實行（計畫）
ex: The company will put new safety rules into effect tomorrow.
公司將於明天實施新的安全規定。
These changes were put into effect to improve efficiency.
這些改變是為了提升效率而實施的。
We are ready to put our strategy into effect immediately.
我們準備好立即實施我們的策略。

items.colloc: put up with the noise 忍受噪音 | put up with the delay 忍受延遲
items.distinct: tolerate 容忍（正式） | stand 忍受（口語）
ex: We cannot put up with such poor service anymore.
我們無法再忍受如此糟糕的服務了。
She has to put up with long commutes every single day.
她每天都必須忍受長途通勤。
Employees should not have to put up with a toxic environment.
員工不該忍受惡劣的工作環境。

items.pos: phr. 無論天氣好壞；風雨無阻
items.colloc: work rain or shine 風雨無阻地工作 | happen rain or shine 無論如何都會發生
items.distinct: no matter what 不管怎樣 | come what may 無論發生什麼
ex: The outdoor event will continue rain or shine.
戶外活動將會風雨無阻地舉行。
Our mail carrier delivers packages rain or shine.
我們的郵差風雨無阻地派送包裹。
We will complete this project on time, rain or shine.
無論如何，我們都會如期完成專案。

items.colloc: reach a firm conclusion 達成明確結論 | fail to reach a conclusion 無法達成結論
items.distinct: come to a decision 做出決定 | draw a conclusion 推論出結果
ex: The board of directors failed to reach a conclusion today.
董事會今天未能達成結論。
We carefully reviewed the data to reach a conclusion.
我們仔細審查數據以得出結論。
It takes time to reach a conclusion on such complex issues.
針對如此複雜的問題，需要時間才能得出結論。

items.zh: 找到解決方法；解決問題
items.colloc: reach the solution quickly 快速找到方法 | reach the optimal solution 達到最佳解
items.distinct: find a way 找到方法 | solve the problem 解決問題
ex: The team worked together to reach the solution effectively.
團隊通力合作以有效地找到解決方案。
We finally reached the solution after several hours of discussion.
經過數小時討論，我們終於找到解決方法。
It is difficult to reach the solution without more information.
沒有更多資訊很難找到解決方案。

items.colloc: react to criticism 對批評做出反應 | react to the news 對消息產生反應
items.distinct: respond to 回應（較積極） | reply to 回覆（文字或口頭）
ex: How did the investors react to the quarterly report?
投資人對季度報告有什麼反應？
The market is starting to react to the new regulations.
市場開始對新法規做出反應。
Management needs to react to employee feedback promptly.
管理層需要及時回應員工的反饋。

items.zh: 不動產銷售；房地產交易
items.colloc: manage a real estate sale 管理房地產銷售 | increase real estate sales 增加銷售額
items.distinct: property transaction 房產交易 | housing market 房地產市場
ex: The real estate sale was finalized late yesterday afternoon.
不動產銷售在昨天下午晚些時候完成。
Our firm specializes in commercial real estate sales.
我們公司專注於商業不動產銷售。
Interest rates have impacted current real estate sales significantly.
利率已顯著影響了當前的房地產銷售。

items.zh: 正常工作時間；辦公時間
items.colloc: during regular working hours 在辦公時間內 | outside regular working hours 在非工作時間
items.distinct: office hours 辦公時間 | shift work 輪班工作
ex: Please call our service center during regular working hours.
請在正常辦公時間內撥打我們的服務中心。
Our technicians are available outside of regular working hours.
我們的技術人員在非工作時間也可提供服務。
She prefers to complete tasks during regular working hours.
她傾向於在正常工作時間內完成任務。

items.colloc: rent out an apartment 出租公寓 | rent out office space 出租辦公空間
items.distinct: lease 出租（長期） | rent from 向他人租入
ex: They plan to rent out the vacant office on the second floor.
他們計畫將二樓的空辦公室出租。
Is it profitable to rent out your property as a studio?
將你的房產作為工作室出租有利可圖嗎？
The owner decided to rent out the building to a startup.
屋主決定將該建築出租給一家新創公司。

items.colloc: call a repair person 請維修人員 | wait for a repair person 等候維修人員
items.distinct: technician 技術人員 | handyman 雜務工
ex: I have scheduled a repair person to fix the printer.
我已預約維修人員來修理印表機。
The repair person arrived earlier than expected this morning.
維修人員今天早上比預期提早到達。
Ask the repair person to provide a written estimate.
請維修人員提供一份書面估價單。

items.colloc: report a problem to IT 回報問題給資訊部 | report a technical problem 回報技術問題
items.distinct: file a complaint 提出投訴 | inform of an issue 通知某問題
ex: Please report any problem you encounter with the software.
請回報您在使用該軟體時遇到的任何問題。
He went to the manager to report a problem with the line.
他向經理報告生產線出現的問題。
Customers can report a problem via our official website.
客戶可以透過我們的官方網站回報問題。

items.colloc: enter a restricted area 進入管制區 | access to restricted areas 進入管制區的權限
items.distinct: private property 私人領地 | prohibited zone 禁止區域
ex: Only authorized personnel may enter this restricted area.
只有授權人員可以進入此管制區。
The warehouse is a restricted area for safety reasons.
基於安全理由，倉庫屬於限制區域。
Please stay away from the restricted area near the construction site.
請遠離工地附近的管制區。

items.colloc: undergo road construction 進行道路施工 | delay due to road construction 因修路而延遲
items.distinct: road work 道路工程（通用） | infrastructure project 基礎建設專案
ex: Road construction will begin on the main highway tomorrow.
主要公路的道路施工明天將會開始。
Expect traffic delays caused by ongoing road construction.
由於進行中的道路施工，請預期交通會有所延誤。
We had to change our route because of road construction.
我們因為道路施工必須改變路線。

items.colloc: follow a road sign 遵守路標 | ignore a road sign 忽略路標
items.distinct: traffic light 紅綠燈 | street sign 街道名稱牌
ex: The road sign clearly indicated the speed limit ahead.
路標清楚地標示了前方的限速。
You should pay attention to every road sign while driving.
駕駛時應注意每一個道路標誌。
The obscured road sign made it difficult to find the turn.
被遮住的路標讓人很難找到轉彎處。

items.colloc: heavy road work 大規模道路工程 | notify of road work 通知道路工程
items.distinct: construction site 工地 | street maintenance 街道維護
ex: There is significant road work happening in the city center.
市中心正在進行重大的道路工程。
The city council announced road work for the next month.
市議會宣布了下個月的道路工程。
Plan your commute carefully during this period of road work.
在這段道路工程期間，請妥善規劃你的通勤。

items.colloc: run a meeting efficiently 有效主持會議 | run a weekly meeting 每週主持會議
items.distinct: chair a meeting 主席主持會議 | lead a discussion 引導討論
ex: She knows how to run a meeting and keep it brief.
她知道如何主持會議並保持簡短。
The CEO will run a meeting regarding the new merger.
執行長將主持一場關於新合併案的會議。
It is challenging to run a meeting with so many participants.
主持一場有這麼多參與者的會議很有挑戰性。
